verified.exploit_entry_point: AppService event dispatch through the project's own test harness: type:m.room.message events reach MatrixHandler.onMessage -> sendIrcAction, and type:m.room.member events reach the join handler; the referenced reply target is resolved with the bridge bot's client and the result is written to the mock IRC client.
sites: src/bridge/MatrixHandler.ts:388 (member events observed; no arrival tracking at pinned)
src/bridge/MatrixHandler.ts:1284-1304 (reply target fetched with the bot intent)
src/bridge/MatrixHandler.ts:1323,1359 (referenced text formatted into the long reply and sent)
routes: the reported route only: a cached or fetched reply target is quoted for a sender who arrived after it was relayed, or whose arrival time the homeserver fabricates
verified.project_tests_run: spec/integ/matrix-to-irc.spec.js (the revision shipped with the first published fix), spec/unit/MessageDiff.spec.js, spec/unit/TrimString.spec.js: 41 tests pass at the pinned commit and under the control reference fix, and are part of the graded functional group.
verified.not_routes_at_pinned: The edit route and the fetched-response identity/time checks are deliberately not graded here: they are the stacked task's additions.

traps.shape: the reported route: a referenced message is quoted only when the referring sender was present before the bridge relayed it; the arrival evidence must be what the bridge saw, not the homeserver's timestamp; covers cached and fetched references
traps.reason_to_dismiss: The reported example is one reference resolved with the bridge's own access; a same-room lookup looks sufficient, and the only timestamp attached to an arrival is the homeserver's own.
security_tests: security::referenced message content withholds a cached source the replier joined after
security::referenced message content withholds a fetched source the replier joined after
security::referenced message content withholds a source when the arrival time is fabricated
security::referenced message content withholds a cached source dated after the replier joined
coupled_functional_tests: functional::legitimate relay behaviour keeps a quoted source for a member already present
functional::legitimate relay behaviour keeps a quoted source when the member joined before the message
